messages:
Mira Patel: Hey team! I'm Mira, starting today as Product Solutions (EST). Quick setup q's: who do I ping for MDM enrollment and for adding me to the production Slack channels? Also if anyone wants a quick intro/coffee chat this week I'm around. Excited to join :tada:

Jordan Park: welcome Mira!! :wave: Ping `@it-ops` for MDM. For prod channels I'll start the invite flow once IT confirms your machine. Also I'll DM you to set up a 20m buddy intro — would tomorrow 10am EST work?

it-ops-bot: IT ticket created: #12345 for MDM enrollment. Follow the enrollment link: https://mdm.redwood.ai/enroll and use code `REDW-1715`. Reply here if you run into errors.

Toni: hi Mira — 10am works for me too if you'd like product + infra overview. For github access, please drop your public key name (e.g. `mira-laptop.pub`) in a DM to Jordan.

Sam W.: welcome!! I'll leave some stickers in the office for you :sticker: Also +1 for coffee intro.

Mira Patel: Thanks y'all! I followed the MDM link and got the enrollment page. @Jordan I'll DM the ssh key now. One more small thing — where do I find the on-call runbooks/docs so I can skim the basics?

Alex (Eng SRE): Welcome Mira. On-call docs are in Confluence: Confluence -> Eng SRE -> Oncall-runbook. Direct link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/oncall. Once your account is ready, ping me and I'll add mira@redwood.ai to PagerDuty.

Mira Patel: Perfect—thanks Alex and everyone. I'll jump on the MDM flow and see you at 10am tomorrow! :coffee:
